pairs: In Israel, his name is great.
Et factus est in pace locus ejus,
And his place has been formed with peace.
And his dwelling place is in Zion.
In that place, he has broken the powers of the bows,
Illuminans tu mirabiliter a montibus æternis;
You illuminate wondrously from the mountains of eternity.
All the foolish of heart have been disturbed.
et nihil invenerunt omnes viri divitiarum in manibus suis.
and all the men of riches have found nothing in their hands.
those who were mounted on horseback have fallen asleep.
et quis resistet tibi? ex tunc ira tua.
who can withstand you? From thence is your wrath.
You have caused judgment to be heard from heaven.
The earth trembled and was quieted,
cum exsurgeret in judicium Deus, ut salvos faceret omnes mansuetos terræ.
when God rose up in judgment in order to bring salvation to all the meek of the earth.
For the thinking of man will confess to you,
et reliquiæ cogitationis diem festum agent tibi.
and the legacy of his thinking will keep a feast day to you.
Make vows and pay them to the Lord,
omnes qui in circuitu ejus affertis munera:
All you who surround him bring gifts:
et ei qui aufert spiritum principum:
even to him who takes away the spirit of leaders,
to him who is terrible with the kings of the earth.
